paper_title: Stellar limits on scalars from electron-nucleus bremsstrahlung
notes: Paper derives observational bounds on baryophilic and leptophilic scalars from white-dwarf cooling (α_B ≲ 3.4×10^-26, α_c ≲ 1.2×10^-32 at 95% CL), but results are presented as single numerical values rather than as curves in the canonical coupling-mass planes. Figure 3 shows constraints on sin θ (Higgs portal mixing angle) vs scalar mass, but sin θ is not a canonical coupling type in AxionLimitBench. Paper is theoretical/observational rather than from direct experimental measurement.
